text:
zoe: FYI I found a quirky behavior in the Next.js LlamaIndex starter: embeddings.batch is returning vectors out-of-order which breaks our eval harness assertions.
paul: ah ok, can you repro locally and share logs?
zoe: repro steps in the sample: clone sample, yarn, run dev, POST /api/embed with ordered ids. logs show request ids [a,b,c] but responses [b,a,c].
maya: which SDK & runtime? node or python?
zoe: @paul using @redwood/sdk@0.8.1 (Node). Python SDK returns ordered results.
samir: sounds like the JS batch implementation returns as results arrive rather than preserving input order. That will definitely break deterministic evals.
paul: opened upstream issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/901
devex-bot: issue #901 created by paul 024-06-03 09:12 labels: sdk,bug,high-prio
zoe: quick workaround added to the sample: env flag REDWOOD_PRESERVE_ORDER=true and a small reorder helper in api/embed.ts that maps by id before returning.
samir: also noticed retry behavior can insert duplicates when a partial batch retry occurs. For eval harness we should dedupe by id before assertions.
maya: assign to @samir and @paul to add a unit test in the eval harness that catches ordering and duplicate regressions.
paul: will add a deterministic sorting step in the harness test for now so flaky CI stops failing, and follow up with SDK fix.
samir: drafting a PR to the JS SDK to add an optional preserveOrder flag defaulting to true for parity with Python; will also harden the retry path to dedupe id collisions.
zoe: I'll submit a sample PR documenting the workaround and include the local repro steps and logs.
paul: preview deploy for sample PR failed due to eval-harness test, rolling back preview. :grimacing:
devex-bot: preview deploy for pr/4321 rolled back reason: ci/tests:eval-harness failed
zoe: sample PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/4321 - contains README note + mapping helper.
maya: once SDK PR lands we can remove the env flag and add an integration test to catch regressions. :thumbsup:
zoe: note saved to devex checklist: "embeddings.batch ordering assumptions".
